correctness.rationale: Re-audited /workspace/repairs/4/RESULT.md and SLOGAN.txt. The original mathematical boundary and coefficient formula are correct; the repair changes the contribution, not the underlying law or limits. The exact published PGF gives distinct numerator factors 1+bs and 1−rs and the double pole factor (1−qs)^(−2), so λ_k=(2q^k−r^k+(−1)^(k+1)b^k)/k as a formal coefficient. The positive zero atom gives n[s^k]G(s)^(1/n)→λ_k, so a negative coefficient rules out arbitrarily fine PGF roots. The b≤q case has strictly positive summable intensities even at equality; the b>q case has positive odd coefficients and eventually negative even coefficients. For fixed θ, ρ=r/q<1 and t=log(b/q)>0, even k is forbidden exactly when exp(kt)+ρ^k>2. Since each finite prefix is strictly positive at t=0, K→infinity. The first even k≥log(2)/t bounds K from above (ρ^k>0), and at K one has log(2−ρ^K)<Kt≤log 2+2t. This proves the exact limit and the finite-prefix consequence without a θ-uniform claim. Independent bounded replay: at θ=1 and b/q=1+1/n, compare the two rational powers (1+1/n)^k+(2/3)^k to 2 for even k starting at 2; n=10,100,1000 give first indices 8,70,694. Also, direct finite expansion of log(G/G(0)) from the convolved rational masses agreed with the formula through degree 11 at three θ values and b below, at, and above q. The supplied script was inspected, not executed.

value.rationale: The repaired claim gives a naturally defined detection index for a false compound-Poisson diagnosis, rather than just observing that some very high coefficient is negative. Above the boundary at fixed θ it shows quantitatively how long every finite sign test can misleadingly pass: the required order grows like log(2)/log(b/q), with exact leading constant and parity. This is an independently useful limitation of truncation diagnostics in a published count family. The already covered cutoff is not used as the basis of the originality or value determination.
